page_title: BOL 2-1 CAG | Bologna v Cagliari 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' The ratio of the ball possession is 71:29.
90+6' The Bologna players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
90+6' The Bologna players joy may have been justified, because referee Daniele Orsato is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
90+5' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90+5' The current number of shots on goal is 7:1.
90+3' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+2' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.

90' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards goal from a promising distance, but Boris Radunovic denies him.
89' 2 - 1 Goal! Boris Radunovic makes a huge mistake and Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 2:1.
88' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
87' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for an infringement.
86' Substitution. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) in, Jesper Karlsson out.
86' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) climbs high to connect with a cross heading towards the edge of the box, but it's a poor header which goes well wide of the left post.
86' Bologna fail to score from a corner as Boris Radunovic (Cagliari) leaps to collect the ball.
86' Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Bologna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
85' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
84' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Michel Aebischer and he is replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefan Posch leaves the pitch and Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) comes on.
83' The ball falls to Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari), but his shot towards the middle of the goal is weak and Lukasz Skorupski makes an easy save.
82' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
82' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
81' The game is interrupted now, Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

80' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) connects with a pin-point cross but blazes the ball high over the bar. His shot wasn't accurate, nor powerful enough. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
79' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
77' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
75' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) fails to score from the penalty spot! His effort only crashes against the crossbar.
75' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is going to take the penalty!
74' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bologna!
74' Referee Daniele Orsato makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bologna. Let’s see what happens!

73' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Bologna.
72' Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lukasz Skorupski comes off the line to clear the ball away.
71' A substitution has been made. Tommaso Augello is replaced by Paulo Daniel Dentello Azzi (Cagliari).
70' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Orsato and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
69' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
68' Bologna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
67' Substitution. Nikola Moro makes way for Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is coming onto the pitch as Dan Ndoye cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Here is a change. Gabriele Zappa is going off and Claudio Ranieri gives the last tactical orders to Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari).
66' Substitution. Jakub Jankto makes his way off the pitch and Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) comes on as his replacement.
63' Ball possession – 74:26.
63' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
59' Shots on target – 2:1.
59' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
59' 1 - 1 Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) neatly controls a decent pass from Victor Kristiansen. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 1:1.
57' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a throw-in.
55' Bologna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
54' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
53' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
51' Bologna have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' A cross from Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.
50' 71:29 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
49' The Bologna players are exchanging some short passes.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Stefan Posch (Bologna).
47' Great teamplay by Bologna as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
46' Claudio Ranieri decides to make a substitution. Andrea Petagna will be replaced by Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari).
46' Half-time substitution. Nahitan Nandez will not participate anymore and Alessandro Di Pardo (Cagliari) is coming on.

46' We are about to witness a substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) is replacing Nahitan Nandez.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.

45+1' The game is pretty dull as Bologna are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.

45' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) releases Jesper Karlsson with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Bologna are taking a throw-in.
44' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
43' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
43' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
42' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
40' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
40' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) was quite harsh and Daniele Orsato didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' Nikola Moro (Bologna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
38' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
38' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle after Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
35' Bologna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
32' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
30' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Boris Radunovic stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
29' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna), but the defence gets it clear. The ball is behind the touchline and Bologna will take a throw-in.
27' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

27' The referee blows his whistle, Cagliari are awarded a corner kick. Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
26' The Cagliari players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
25' Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
24' Nikola Moro (Bologna) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
22' 0 - 1 Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
21' The referee blows his whistle as Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) was too aggressive in his challenge.
20' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will take a throw-in.
19' Neat passing move from Cagliari in order to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
14' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
14' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 82:18.
12' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
10' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

7' Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) gets into a shooting position! What a long-range cannonball of a shot! His nice effort, however, only crashes against the left post. Aim better, sir. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
6' The ball is cleared after Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
